=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:10193-10216 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The new `runs_window_incomplete` gate in heal_stale_decision returns `done("keep", "runs_window_incomplete")` whenever the single runs page (per_page = HEAL_STALE_GREEN_RUNS+10, default 15, cap 100) has no run at or before the anchor and `total_count` exceeds the page length. A held issue on a busy branch is therefore kept on every tick, even when the workflow stays green. The `total_count` value comes from the projection at scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:19220-19230.
  WHY: The anchor only moves on a new trusted occurrence comment, so #8352 (anchor 2026-10-29, busy `main`) and every long-held heal issue can never close. This contradicts condition 4 and the rollout criterion "On the first poller tick after merge, #8352 should close". The tests miss it because poller fixtures set `total_count: len(runs)` (tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:3219, 3228), and `test_heal_stale_keeps_when_the_runs_page_may_not_reach_the_anchor` (tests/test_workflow_failure_heal.py:10164-10180) locks the behaviour in. Severity disagreement: sonnet, minimax and glm rate it BLOCKER, luna rates it MAJOR; the highest (BLOCKER→critical) is used.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:22303-22381 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `_fetch_candidate_issue_details_graphql` uses `timelineItems(last: 50, itemTypes: [CROSS_REFERENCED_EVENT])` with no pagination. An open `ai/issue-<n>` fix PR whose cross-reference is older than the last 50 events, or that never cross-references the issue, is not detected. The linked-PR fallback in `_heal_stale_close_check` (lines 19183-19198 / 19245-19256) and the consumer at scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:10174-10178 then treat it as "no linked PR", which bypasses the open-PR guard.
  WHY: The held heal issue can close as completed while its fix PR is still open, which violates "No open PR has head ai/issue-<n>". Reviewers disagree on the mechanism: gemini says `open_issue_branch_pr` returns "unknown" and is treated as no PR; glm says the value is `null`, not "unknown", and gets parsed to `None`. Severity: luna and glm rate it MAJOR; gemini gave no severity.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:19229 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The `orchestrate-poll (2)` check-run failed on head 289a07dd, and the available artifacts do not tie the failure to a code site. The pre-push gate blames shellcheck plus test_orchestrate_lib.py, test_files_touched_scope_guard.py and test_workflow_checkout_integration_ref_audit.py.
  WHY: The editor should check the full shard log, especially `test_complete_verdict_falls_through_to_finalize_on_integration_drift`, and should not assume the mock opt-in at tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:2539 fixed it.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "On the first poller tick after merge, #8352 should close." Condition 4: "at least HEAL_STALE_GREEN_RUNS completed push runs created after the anchor, and every one of them concluded success", read with one `per_page=<HEAL_STALE_GREEN_RUNS+10>` call; "closes a held, run-sourced issue with N green runs after the anchor"
  expected_change_site: scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py heal_stale_decision runs-window evaluation (lines 10209-10216); supporting projection in scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh _heal_stale_close_check
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The `runs_window_incomplete` gate at scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:10209-10216 makes `close` unreachable whenever `total_count > len(runs["workflow_runs"])` and no page entry precedes the anchor, and the issue's design asks for no page-coverage condition. The `cut` test at tests/test_workflow_failure_heal.py:10164-10180 (total_count=40, 5 runs all post-anchor) encodes this as desired behaviour. No poller fixture exercises a page with `total_count` larger than the page. #8352 can never close.
- requirement: Tests: "keeps it with an open ai/issue-<n> PR, and on a linked-PR cache miss", "does not post a duplicate marker", plus the close-failure retry ("a marker already exists, so only the PATCH is retried" — `close_failed` path)
  expected_change_site: tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py stale-close poller fixtures (`fail_issue_state_patch_for` mock key, line 2544)
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: No fixture sets `fail_issue_state_patch_for`; it appears only at its definition (line 2544, mock handler at 2539-2556). No poller fixture drives `outcome=kept reason=close_failed`, `linked_pr_unknown` or `comment_failed` (scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:19265-19269) end to end. The cache-miss case is covered only by pure-function tests in tests/test_workflow_failure_heal.py (`test_heal_stale_decision_cli` / `linked_pr=HEAL_STALE_LINKED_PR_UNKNOWN`).
- requirement: "no open same-repository PR with head ai/issue-<n> cross-references the issue."
  expected_change_site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh (_fetch_candidate_issue_details_graphql timeline query)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: The timeline query uses `last: 50` without pagination, so it misses older cross-references outside the most recent 50 timeline events.
- requirement: "Log `HEAL_STALE_CLOSE ...` and send a Telegram `INFO`." (Behaviour -> On close)
  expected_change_site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh _heal_stale_close_check close path (around line 19287)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The close notification is sent at level `DEBUG` (scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:19287), not `INFO`. The deviation is documented as intentional in agents.d/8808-heal-stale-auto-close.md, because `INFO` is filtered at the default `WARNING` threshold and rejected by tests/test_alert_levels_human_only.py, but the literal spec is not met.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:heal_stale_decision, lines 10194-10216 (fed by scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:19229 `total_count: (.total_count // null)`) | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The `reaches_anchor`/`page_complete` gate keeps the issue unless the single page of 15 runs reaches the anchor or holds every counted run. On a branch with more than 15 post-anchor push runs, it returns `runs_window_incomplete` on every tick.
  WHY: #8352 (held since 2026-10-29, busy `main`) gets a deterministic keep, so the rollout criterion cannot be met. The gate is unnecessary because a recurrence goes through the intake `duplicate` path (scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:2410-2427; compose-occurrence at scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:7942), whose trusted occurrence comment moves the anchor forward (lines 10181-10187). The fixtures mock `total_count: len(runs)` (tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:3228), and the `cut`/`missing` cases in `test_heal_stale_keeps_when_the_runs_page_may_not_reach_the_anchor` lock the behaviour in. Fix: drop the return, or keep only when the page has fewer than `green_runs` post-anchor runs and does not reach the anchor.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:_heal_stale_close_check runs projection, line 19229; failing check `orchestrate-poll (2)` on head 289a07dd | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The CI shard failed, but the log tail shows only passing tests (e.g. `test_standalone_heal_stale_close_caps_green_runs_at_ninety`). The pre-push gate blames shellcheck plus test_orchestrate_lib.py, test_files_touched_scope_guard.py and test_workflow_checkout_integration_ref_audit.py, and none of them reference the last-run hunks.
  WHY: The failure cannot be tied to a code site. The editor should check the full log, especially `test_complete_verdict_falls_through_to_finalize_on_integration_drift`, and should not assume the mock opt-in at tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:2539 fixed it.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "On the first poller tick after merge, #8352 should close." Condition 4 asks for "at least HEAL_STALE_GREEN_RUNS completed push runs created after the anchor, and every one of them concluded success", read with one `per_page=<HEAL_STALE_GREEN_RUNS+10>` call.
  Expected change site: scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py heal_stale_decision, the runs-window evaluation at lines 10209-10216.
  Evidence of absence: The `runs_window_incomplete` gate means no issue whose anchor is older than the newest 15 push runs can close, #8352 included. The issue adds no page-coverage condition, and no poller fixture exercises `total_count` larger than the page.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: Tests: "keeps it with an open ai/issue-<n> PR, and on a linked-PR cache miss", plus the retry when a trusted marker already exists (only the close is retried).
  Expected change site: tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py stale-close fixtures.
  Evidence of absence: No fixture sets the `fail_issue_state_patch_for` mock key (line 2544). No poller fixture drives `outcome=kept reason=close_failed` or `linked_pr_unknown` end to end; the cache miss is covered only by pure-function tests in tests/test_workflow_failure_heal.py.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
- HARDENING: scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py heal_stale_decision, lines 10209-10216. Suggested fix: remove the `runs_window_incomplete` return, or keep only when the page has fewer than `green_runs` post-anchor runs and does not reach the anchor, and update the `cut`/`missing` assertions in tests/test_workflow_failure_heal.py. Estimated 4-8 lines. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3
